description: Check a prepaid channel’s remaining Bitcoin BSV balance, spend, and request count. Uses the Authorization header or apiKey. On failure returns isError "error: <code> (<status>): <message>": no_channel_key, or invalid_channel (401/404: not found, bad secret, or closed).

apiKey.description: channelId:channelSecret. Omit to use the Authorization header (preferred).

name: channel_balance
